text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way back from
an outing with Hishi Amazon...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainy.
Got some time after this?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If you're free,
there's something I'd like to show you.
choice_data_list: What did you want to show me?
What do you want to show me?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Well then,
how about we save the surprise for when we get there?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: See? You can look out over the whole town from up here.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, from just this,
it looks like nothing more than an ordinary hilltop, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oops, looks like it's just about time.
From the hilltop, the town dyed crimson by the setting sun is in full view.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Pretty impressive, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I happened to find it when I came to this hill for slope training before.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
After sprinting straight up that slope,
seeing this sunset completely blew my exhaustion away.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Since you're here,
I figured I'd show you too."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I always figured the sunset was something you watched down by the riverbank after a one-on-one showdown, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "In a place with this kind of atmosphere, it puts you in a totally different mood, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: If you like, do you want to stick around and watch the next one too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, why don't you have a seat on that bench over there?
Let's take a little breather."

The sun was beginning to set, but as I waited on the bench
as Hishi Amazon had told me to...
This time, the lights of the city spread across her view.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Who knew there was a spot
with such a night view so close to Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
For a city, the air is pretty clean here,
and you can see the stars really well.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"You take good care of me, Trainy.
Consider this my way of saying thanks for everything."
choice_data_list: Thanks, that's so like you, Hishi Amazon
Thanks, that's so like you, Hishi Amazon

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"You take good care of me, Trainy.
Consider this my way of saying thanks for everything."
choice_data_list: Thanks, that's so like you, Hishi Amazon
Thanks, that's so like you, Hishi Amazon

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
Well, they do say fools and smoke love high places.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was a kid,
reaching the top of somewhere high always felt so damn refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We used to race each other up trees
and scramble over giant boulders back in the day.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, despite how I look,
I was raised out in the American countryside, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I remember jumping off a huge rock at the campsite
and getting scraped up once.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The night sky we saw back then was beautiful,
...but this place is pretty amazing too.

Along with some pretty wild nostalgic stories,
I enjoyed the night view with Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hah!?
I'm not that kind of snob!
choice_data_list: No, I was just thinking how cute you are.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I-Idiot! Who are you calling that, huh?!
Don't go talking like Fuji!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm the head of the Miho Dormitory that even crying children fear, Big Sis Hishiama, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Geez...! Look at you, Trainee, talking all big now!

I thought the way she got so worked up was cute,
but kept it to myself since she'd probably get genuinely mad.
